title: Church Road, Carrigaline, Co. Cork
description:
TO LET  *** All enquiries by email only to dennehyauctioneers.rentals@gmail.com*** Please include a short bio with your email.
Dennehy Auctioneers are delighted to present this beautifully modernised, fully furnished, three bedroom detached bungalow, set on approximately 0.33 hectares of mature, private gardens with stunning views overlooking the Owenabue River Estuary. The property offers a spacious and comfortable living environment, combining modern interiors with a peaceful rural setting. Constructed with a timber frame and benefiting from oil-fired central heating, the bungalow provides an ideal combination of character, privacy and convenience. The generous grounds offer excellent outdoor space, while the elevated position overlooking the estuary provides an attractive and tranquil outlook. 
Accommodation comprises of Front Porch, Reception Hall, Sitting Room, Open Plan Kitchen/Dining/Living Room, Large Utility, Three Bedrooms, Bathroom, Jack & Jill style shower Room, Large Storeroom, Spacious Garage.
